purpose: Teach: サンプリング/割愛/懸案/編入/確固たる/バックグラウンド/アウトプット/転嫁

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、品質サンプリングを重視された
lines.en: Father always placed great value on quality sampling from the very beginning.
lines.style: Gentle, measured recollection. Pause after 'Father'—respectful distance. Slow cadence, each phrase deliberate. Trailing warmth, as if seeing him still.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは無駄な作業を割愛された
lines.en: Yes. He never wasted effort on unnecessary work.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Nod in the voice. Steady pace, grounded. Light emphasis on 'never'—not defensive, just factual. Warm underscore of recognition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、長期懸案に丁寧に対処された
lines.en: Father handled every long-standing problem with real care.
lines.style: Soft, almost tender. Each word given its weight. Slow. Eyes slightly closed in memory. Trailing off gently—almost a sigh at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは中途編入社員も平等に扱われた
lines.en: Yes. He treated everyone equally, even those who joined mid-career.
lines.style: Nod-like certainty in the opening. Steady rhythm. Emphasis on 'everyone'—this mattered to him. Quiet pride underneath. Breath of reflection before closing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、確固たる経営理念をお持ちだった
lines.en: Father had principles that were truly unshakeable.
lines.style: Reverent pause after 'Father'. Slow, each phrase distinct. Warmth rising slightly on 'unshakeable'—this is the core. Tender fadeout, like a benediction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員のバックグラウンドを尊重された
lines.en: Yes. He respected where everyone came from, who they were.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Gentle expansion on 'respected'—this was active, not passive. Warm, connected tone. Slight breath before 'who they were'—that part mattered most.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員のアウトプットを大切にされた
lines.en: Father truly valued what his people produced.
lines.style: Soft, almost protective tone. Slow cadence. Warmth in 'valued'—not duty, but genuine care. Trailing tenderness, as if speaking of something precious and irreplaceable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは責任を社員に転嫁されなかった
lines.en: Yes. He never shifted blame onto his staff.
lines.style: Final quiet affirmation. Slow, measured. Emphasis on 'never'—a cornerstone of his character. Pause at the end, letting that integrity settle. Breath of closure and respect.
